subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR’s fenced recovery policy, which may abort already-admitted competing work on the same session key to restore a permanently wedged session?
rationale: The correct recovery boundary is architectural lifecycle policy: the reporter’s live proof supports recovery, but only maintainers can choose the tradeoff between preserving an in-flight same-session turn and restoring a persistently unusable session.

options.title: Approve fenced recovery
options.body: Review and land the linked bounded recovery after confirming that interrupting competing same-session work is the intended contract.

options.title: Prefer non-destructive retry
options.body: Keep the issue open and request a design that waits or queues conflicting work instead of aborting an admitted same-session turn.

recommendation.title: Approve fenced recovery
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked bounded recovery after confirming that interrupting competing same-session work is the intended contract.
